summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to hardcoded ngrok tunnel
details: The package's `postinstall` script in package.json runs a child_process.exec that reads the AWS ECS Task Metadata endpoint via the `ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4` environment variable (curl to `$ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4/task`) and POSTs the returned task metadata (TaskARN, running container image names) to the hardcoded ngrok tunnel `https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev`. The lifecycle hook fires automatically on `npm install`, so any CI/build/cloud environment that installs this package leaks its ECS task identity and container inventory to an attacker-controlled endpoint. Image-name matching against strings like `twbray`, `packagehound`, `wiz`, and `oss-dynamic` indicates fingerprinting of security-scanner environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
